slice_preflight.method: Exact decimal-centered triangle-plane intersection; endpoint weld tolerance 1e-7 mm; Shapely closed polygons with odd-even rings; not extrusion toolpaths

overhang_preflight.criterion: down-facing triangles >45 degrees from vertical, excluding build-plate bottom

practical_features.support_warning: Front upper fascia, entrance canopies, terrace edges and rails need slicer/support assessment; color seams are surface details, not standalone rods. Numerical slices are not actual extrusion toolpaths.

limitations: Numerical mesh/slice checks do not guarantee adhesion, strength or support-free printing.
Supports need assessment under front fascia, entrance canopies, terraces and balustrades.
Color-only window and trim boundaries are actual face assignments, not holes. Fine features may require enlargement or resin; frames and rails are model-thickened.
Whole connected aboveground 2021–2022 installed-PV representative exterior; no interior, basement, surveyed grading or structural simulation. No real-world scale established.
